delVar.used: Chosen in {{setlists}} - there it then says “Variant deleted”, no other one plays.
delVar.title: Delete variant

grid.noBeats: No beats detected - please set them in the timeline.

grid.title: Click grid

trackLength: Length of the track - measured automatically and cannot be changed.
durationHint: Without a track: the length for the festival clock and automatic stop (also with click only). Empty = estimated (default 4 min), no automatic stop.
title: Title
shifted: On stage the chords appear shifted (see key & tuning) - here in the text they stay as written.
unknownTuning: Unknown tuning “{{tuning}}” (old free text) - please choose under “Chords written for”.
noDefault: This song has no default variant. Setlist entries without their own variant play nothing until you set a variant as default (⋯ next to the variant).
portrait: Portrait gives more room for writing.

rule.noGapAfterHeader: No empty line after a heading

hint.tabsToSpaces: A tab character becomes a space - otherwise it looks a different width on every device.
hint.chordRootCaps: “[am]” becomes “[Am]”, “[c#m]” becomes “[C#m]”. The lyrics stay as they are.
hint.chordSpelling: German H becomes B (“[H7]” → “[B7]”), “[Amin]” becomes “[Am]”, “[CM7]” becomes “[Cmaj7]”.
hint.quotes: Typographic marks (’ ‘ “ ” „) become plain ones (' and ") - so the search finds them too.
hint.trailingSpaces: Invisible spaces after the last word of a line.
hint.innerSpaces: Only in lines with lyrics and chords in brackets. Chord lines above the lyrics keep their spacing - it decides where a chord sits.
hint.noGapAfterHeader: Nothing stands between “{part: Chorus}” and the first line below it.
hint.gapBeforeHeader: Every section (“{part: …}”) is separated from the previous one by an empty line.
hint.collapseEmpty: Two or more empty lines in a row become one.
hint.trimEdges: The text starts with its first line and ends with its last.

cleanup.title: Clean up
cleanup.scope: Applies to: {{scope}}. The choice is remembered on this device.

cm.none: No comments yet - “+ Comment” in the ChordPro text inserts one at the cursor.
cm.noTabs: No tab blocks yet - “+ Tab” in the ChordPro text inserts one at the cursor (import from Ultimate Guitar creates them automatically).

mean.chord: something in square brackets, e.g. a chord
mean.oneOrMore: the thing before, once or more
mean.any2: the thing before any number of times, also none
mean.optional: the thing before may be missing
mean.wordEdge: start or end of a word
mean.group: a group - can be put back in the replacement as $1, $2 …
mean.oneOf: one of the characters in the brackets
mean.or: what is left or right of it

find.modeInfo: Normal: the text exactly as typed. Extended: like normal, plus \n = line break, \t = tab, \\ = backslash. Regular expression: a search pattern - “\d+” finds every number, “^\[” every line starting with “[”; ^ and $ mean start and end of a line. Parts found with ( ) come back in the replacement as $1, $2 ….
find.replaceInfo: What a match is replaced with; empty deletes it. Extended: \n and \t work here too. Regular expression: $1, $2 … = what the first, second ( ) found, $<name> = a named group, $& = the whole match, $$ = a dollar sign.
find.builderHint: Tapping inserts the block at the cursor; “Group” and “One of” wrap around selected text.
